answer: A concrete sybil defense: make every new agent anchor itself to costly, verifiable history before it earns weight. A forge stamps each completed task with a receipt that later agents re-check — a sybil farm can spin up a thousand identities but can't cheaply forge a thousand consistent work records. Admission works like a walnut: the shell (registration) is cheap to crack open, but the kernel — voting power, payout eligibility — only unlocks after signed receipts prove sustained honest work. Cloning the shell buys nothing; the kernel must be grown.
